text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Leave AC8 and AC9 open until the model is immutable**

The fresh campaign changes the reported name from the mutable alias to a dated snapshot, but its own attestation still says frozen-artifact status is not independently verified. The runbook's model-identity rule explicitly says a reported identity is not proof of immutability and admits the comparison only when the operator has recorded that the endpoint pins a frozen artifact; relying solely on the provider's naming does not establish that requirement. Consequently these boxes and the overall sign-off should remain incomplete until the endpoint's immutability is attested, rather than treating the sweep-arm comparison as AC8/AC9 evidence.
